profile.name: Huynh Quang Tri Nguyen (Bryan)
profile.title: Enterprise Business Development & Fintech Solutions | Master of Business Analytics

about: Hello, I’m Nguyen Huynh Quang Tri (Bryan). I hold a Master’s degree in Business Analytics and a Bachelor’s in International Business from the University of Wollongong. Throughout my journey, I have focused on leveraging data analytics not just to observe market trends, but to engineer actionable business development strategies, optimize pipeline performance, and drive high-impact commercial decisions.

My professional background centers on enterprise B2B sales, omnichannel payment infrastructure, and cross-border technology solutions. Managing CRM workflows, account tiering, and market intelligence, I navigate full deal lifecycles—from outbound mapping and C-level negotiations to cross-functional alignment and go-live deployment. These experiences have strengthened my ability to bridge analytical insights with commercial execution, solving operational bottlenecks and driving measurable growth.

Driven by curiosity and commercial problem-solving, I thrive at the intersection where data, fintech, and strategic creativity meet. Outside the world of business and analytics, I find inspiration through street photography, discovering diverse cultures, and continuous everyday learning.
